# AI Wise

> AI Wise is the one-person practice of Simon van Meegdenburg. He uses AI to
> build apps, websites, tools and agents, ideally for organisations doing work
> that matters. Many of them take over repetitive work.
> Tagline: Automation in Service of Life.

The website is a single page in Dutch and English. It describes what has become
possible, gives examples, introduces Simon and explains how to get in touch. It
deliberately carries no service catalogue, no pricing and no productised offer.

## What has changed

Having a website, app or tool built has become far more attainable. AI shortens
the path from a clear idea to a working system, and what used to be a major
project is now manageable. That opens the door for small practices and
organisations doing meaningful work. A good idea can start small and still make
a real difference. AI is the method here, not the subject.

## Examples

The website gives these as examples of what is possible, to think with. They
are not a service catalogue.

- A modernised website.
- A webshop alongside a practice.
- An online teaching space to complement in-person classes.
- Sign-ups landing straight in the records.
- Participants who manage their own bookings or memberships.
- Meeting notes processed automatically.
- An agent that takes over the most tedious task.

## About Simon

- He has been building data systems since 2018, first as a BI consultant and
  later as a data engineer.
- In his spare time he learned to build websites and apps, and realised he
  enjoys that even more.
- With AI, he can turn an idea into a first prototype in about a day.
- Experimenting taught him what it takes to build a system ready for everyday
  use.
- He is happiest building for organisations he feels connected to.

## What the website does not include

- No pricing, packages or scope.
- No case studies, client names or testimonials, because none are confirmed for
  public use.
- No claims about time saved, safety or privacy outcomes.

## Contact

The site invites anyone with an idea they would like to see built, a website
that is overdue for an update, or work that keeps coming back, even if it is not
fully thought through yet. AI Wise is young and Simon is still discovering where
he can be most useful.

It also invites collaboration. Other developers are welcome to compare notes on
how they work, since AI moves so fast that people get further together than on
their own. Designers and content writers are welcome to take on design and
writing, so Simon can focus on building the functionality.

Contact runs by email at simon@aiwise.it.com, through LinkedIn, or by WhatsApp on
+31 6 13926494. A short message will do. There is no contact form.

## Crawling

Regular search crawlers, AI search and discovery crawlers, and user-triggered
fetchers are welcome to read and cite this site. Model-training crawlers are
disallowed in robots.txt; that is a deliberate and separate choice from being
findable in AI-assisted search.
